decks.notes: The deck focuses on utilizing the Dark Depths combo, which involves using Vampire Hexmage or Thespian's Stage to remove all ice counters from Dark Depths and create a 20/20 Marit Lage token. The strategy involves using disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Duress to control the opponent's hand while employing cards like Dark Ritual to accelerate the combo. The deck also includes cards like Dauthi Voidwalker to disrupt opponents' graveyard strategies. The goal is to efficiently assemble the combo and win through a powerful, hard-to-interact-with threat in Marit Lage.

The focus of this deck is to efficiently and quickly assemble the combo of Doomsday and Thassa's Oracle to win the game. The deck includes card draw and filtering spells like Ponder and Brainstorm to set up the combo, as well as protection with Force of Will and disruption with Duress and Thoughtseize. Rituals such as Dark Ritual and Cabal Ritual help accelerate mana production, while Lion's Eye Diamond provides additional mana. The deck is designed to combo off quickly and efficiently to secure victory in Legacy 1 vs 1 matchups.

The main concept of this UWx Control deck is to control the game through card advantage, removal spells, and counter magic while utilizing powerful planeswalkers like Narset, Parter of Veils and Teferi, Time Raveler. The deck also aims to generate additional value through cards like Monastery Mentor and Snapcaster Mage. The inclusion of versatile spells like Prismatic Ending, Swords to Plowshares, and Brainstorm allows for flexibility in dealing with different threats. Overall, the deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan while setting up its own win conditions.

This deck focuses on leveraging the power of artifacts, specifically in the blue color. By utilizing cards like Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Urza's Saga, the deck aims to rapidly deploy threats and disrupt opponents with Chalice of the Void and Force of Will. The key strategy is to generate card advantage with cards like Thoughtcast and Thought Monitor while maintaining a strong board presence with artifact creatures like Sai, Master Thopterist. The deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain control through the mid to late game using a combination of aggro tactics and artifact synergies.

This deck focuses on generating mana through creatures like Elvish Reclaimer, Heritage Druid, and Gaea's Cradle to power out explosive combo plays. The deck aims to quickly assemble a board of Elves to set up for a game-ending Craterhoof Behemoth or Archon of Valor's Reach. Glimpse of Nature and Green Sun's Zenith help to draw through the deck and find key combo pieces, while cards like Natural Order provide additional ways to cheat out powerful threats. The deck has a toolbox approach with cards like Endurance and Collector Ouphe to disrupt opponents' strategies while going off with its own combo pieces.

The main idea of this Legacy combo Elves deck is to generate a large amount of mana using cards like Gaea's Cradle and Heritage Druid, while drawing through the deck with cards like Elvish Visionary and Glimpse of Nature. This allows the player to quickly assemble a powerful board state and combo off with cards like Natural Order to bring out a game-winning Craterhoof Behemoth. The deck also includes disruption elements like Allosaurus Shepherd and Collector Ouphe to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's strategy.

The key concept of this deck is to generate mana quickly and efficiently to cast powerful spells like Echo of Eons and Galvanic Relay. The deck focuses on using artifacts like Mox Opal and Lion's Eye Diamond to ramp up mana production, while also utilizing cards like Burning Wish and Wish to tutor for key combo pieces. The inclusion of cards like Defense Grid helps to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Ultimately, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of powerful spells and win the game through explosive combo plays.

The main strategy of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo pieces of Cephalid Illusionist, Nomads en-Kor, and a creature like Narcomoeba to mill your deck and win the game with Thassa's Oracle. The deck also includes ways to protect the combo pieces, such as Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares. Additionally, the deck has cards like Recruiter of the Guard and Stoneforge Mystic to tutor for the pieces needed. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion provides value and extra resources for a long game.

This deck focuses on utilizing cheap and efficient spells to control the board while establishing a fast and aggressive game plan. By aggressively using cards like Lightning Bolt and Delver of Secrets to control the opponent's creatures and life total, combined with disruptive cards like Force of Will and Daze to protect key threats, the deck aims to quickly close out the game with powerful flying threats like Murktide Regent. The mana base is streamlined for consistency, with a focus on tempo plays and disrupting the opponent's game plan.

The main idea behind this deck is to cast a lot of cheap spells like Dark Ritual and Lotus Petal, generate a ton of mana, and then use that mana to cast Tendrils of Agony or Ad Nauseam to win the game in one explosive turn. The deck includes plenty of ways to dig through the library for the key combo pieces, as well as protection in the form of Duress and Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The goal is to execute the combo as quickly and efficiently as possible to overwhelm the opponent.

This deck focuses on controlling the opponent's resources through a combination of disruption and resource denial. The key strategy revolves around using cards like Dark Confidant, Elvish Reclaimer, Knight of the Reliquary, and Green Sun's Zenith to establish board presence while utilizing cards like Swords to Plowshares and Collector Ouphe to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of cards like Life from the Loam and Urza's Saga provides additional value and utility, allowing the player to outvalue their opponent over time. Additionally, the deck includes various lands to provide mana fixing and utility for different situations.

This deck focuses on playing aggressively with cheap, efficient creatures and spells while disrupting the opponent's game plan. By leveraging powerful tempo plays and a low mana curve, the deck aims to apply early pressure while maintaining control of the game through counterspells and land disruption. The key concept is to quickly deploy threats and disrupt the opponent's plans, pushing for a swift victory before the opponent can establish a strong board presence or stabilize.

The key concept of this deck is to use efficient spells and disruptive elements to control the board while aggressively attacking the opponent's life total. Utilizing powerful tempo plays like Daze and Force of Will, along with threats like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Murktide Regent, the deck aims to apply pressure quickly and disrupt the opponent's game plan. By combining card advantage and aggressive threats, this UR Tempo deck aims to control the game and outpace the opponent to secure victory.

The deck aims to efficiently combo off by using Cephalid Illusionist and Nomads en-Kor to mill the library, then use Dread Return to reanimate Thassa's Oracle for a win. The deck utilizes various forms of protection such as Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares to protect the combo pieces and disrupt opponent strategies. Aether Vial helps to quickly get the combo creatures onto the battlefield while Stoneforge Mystic tutors up equipment to help control the board. The deck also has a Yorion, Sky Nomad companion for additional value and flexibility.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through the use of lands, utilizing cards like Life from the Loam, Exploration, and Manabond to maximize land plays. The key strategy revolves around creating a lock with cards like Wasteland and Rishadan Port to disrupt the opponent's mana base while generating value from lands like Field of the Dead and Dark Depths. By efficiently managing lands and utilizing powerful utility lands like Maze of Ith and Karakas, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent in a slow and methodical manner.

This deck utilizes Doomsday as its main win condition, using a combination of card draw, tutors, and counterspells to set up a game-winning combo with Thassa's Oracle. By carefully managing resources and making strategic decisions, the pilot can quickly assemble the necessary pieces to execute the combo and secure victory. The deck prioritizes efficient card manipulation and protection to ensure the combo can be executed successfully, while also having the flexibility to disrupt opponents' strategies. With careful planning and skillful play, this deck can be a powerful force in the Legacy format.
